summary.zh: SOXX盘前约+0.9%，SK海力士财报大超预期、股价大涨约11%，美光盘前+3.5%，纳指期货+0.4%，缺口预计约+1.0%。昨日SOX已大涨3.6%，加上美联储下午2点决议、10年期收益率近5%、油价回升，开盘后略有回吐，预计开盘后约-0.2%，全天约+0.8%。
summary.en: SOXX is up about 0.9% pre-market after SK Hynix's record results (+11% in Seoul); Micron is +3.5% and Nasdaq futures +0.4%, so I expect a gap near +1.0%. After yesterday's 3.6% jump, a 2 PM Fed decision, a 10-year yield near 5% and firmer oil argue for a small fade, about -0.2% after the open.

factors.zh: SK海力士创纪录财报，股价+10.9%，美光盘前+3.5%
factors.en: SK Hynix record results, +10.9% in Seoul; Micron +3.5% pre-market

factors.zh: 亚洲芯片强：东京电子+4.4%，KOSPI +6.6%；设备股盘前涨1.6-2.2%
factors.en: Asia chips strong: Tokyo Electron +4.4%, KOSPI +6.6%; US equipment +1.6-2.2% pre-market

factors.zh: 昨日SOX已涨3.6%，模型预测开盘后约-0.2%
factors.en: SOX already +3.6% yesterday; model sees about -0.2% after the open

factors.zh: 美联储下午2点决议，10年期收益率4.99%，WTI原油101.65
factors.en: Fed decision at 2 PM; 10-year yield 4.99%, WTI crude 101.65

factors.zh: 英伟达+0.8%、台积电+0.2%涨幅有限，恩智浦-8%拖累模拟芯片
factors.en: Nvidia +0.8% and TSM +0.2% are muted; NXP -8% drags analog chips

risk.zh: 若美联储措辞偏鹰、收益率突破5%，或存储股冲高回落，SOX可能转跌。
risk.en: A hawkish Fed tone, a 10-year yield break above 5%, or memory stocks reversing their pre-market pop could turn the day negative.

views.en: SK Hynix's 632% profit surge and large shareholder-return pledge are lifting Micron and SanDisk along with it.
views.zh: SK海力士利润暴增632%并承诺大额股东回报，带动美光和闪迪走高。

views.en: AI stocks are rebounding as SK Hynix jumps 11% and Micron and Sandisk gain about 4%.
views.zh: SK海力士大涨11%，美光和闪迪约涨4%，AI股反弹。

views.en: Broadcom's big Anthropic deal powered a 308-point Nasdaq jump on Tuesday, setting up the chip rebound that continues this morning.
views.zh: 博通的Anthropic大单推动纳指周二上涨308点，芯片反弹延续到今早。
